Question B-003-021-004.

Why the correct answer is right: Keeping the handheld antenna away from the head reduces local RF exposure to nearby tissue.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "To reduce your exposure to the radio frequency energy": This is the correct choice because keeping the handheld antenna away from the head reduces local RF exposure to nearby tissue.
- sourceIndex 1: "To use your body to reflect the signal in one direction": This is a near-miss because it shifts attention from To reduce your exposure to the radio frequency energy. In RF exposure controls for UHF, microwave, handheld, indoor, dipole, and high-gain antennas, it names a different cause, control, component, or safety action than the one required here.
- sourceIndex 2: "To keep static charges from building up": This answer would fit a different fault than To reduce your exposure to the radio frequency energy. In RF exposure controls for UHF, microwave, handheld, indoor, dipole, and high-gain antennas, it names a different cause, control, component, or safety action than the one required here.
- sourceIndex 3: "To help the antenna radiate energy equally in all directions": This option confuses another station topic with To reduce your exposure to the radio frequency energy. In RF exposure controls for UHF, microwave, handheld, indoor, dipole, and high-gain antennas, antenna details matter in station design, but this choice does not address the tested hazard or function.
